proof_body:
by
  intro K _ _ h2 h0
  have h1 := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank K
  have h3 := NumberField.InfinitePlace.card_eq_nrRealPlaces_add_nrComplexPlaces (K := K)
  have h4 := NumberField.Units.finrank_eq K
  have hr : NumberField.Units.rank K = 0 := by
    rw [NumberField.Units.rank]; omega
  have hall : ∀ u : (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ, u ∈ NumberField.Units.torsion K := by
    intro u
    have hz : Module.finrank ℤ (Additive (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ) = 0 := by rw [h4, hr]
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hu⟩ := (Module.finrank_eq_zero_iff.1 hz) (Additive.ofMul u)
    rw [NumberField.Units.torsion, CommGroup.mem_torsion, isOfFinOrder_iff_zpow_eq_one]
    exact ⟨a, ha, by simpa using congrArg Additive.toMul hu⟩
  exact Finite.of_injective (fun u => (⟨u, hall u⟩ : NumberField.Units.torsion K)) (fun a b h => by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val h)
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K], Module.finrank ℚ K = 2 → NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K = 0 → Finite (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)ˣ
